verses.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਸਰਗੁਨ ਕੈ ਅਲਖ ਅਬਿਗਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਰੁ ਰੂਪ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਏ ਹੈਂ ॥
verses.translit_en: niragun saragun kai alakh abigat gat pooran braham gur roop pragaTaae hai(n) ||

en.bdb: The Supreme Lord whose countenance is beyond perception, who is indestructible, despite being formless took human form and revealed Himself as Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਰਗੁਨ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਦਰਸ ਕੈ ਧਿਆਨ ਰੂਪ ਅਕਲ ਅਕਾਲ ਗੁਰੁਸਿਖਨ ਦਿਖਾਏ ਹੈਂ ॥
verses.translit_en: saragun sree gur dharas kai dhiaan roop akal akaal gurusikhan dhikhaae hai(n) ||

en.bdb: God in His immanent form as Satguru who is beyond all castes, creed and race make the Sikhs realise the true form of God.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਬਦ ਅਨਹਦ ਧੁਨਿ ਸਬਦ ਬੇਧੀ ਗੁਰੁਸਿੱਖਨ ਸੁਨਾਏ ਹੈਂ ॥
verses.translit_en: niragun sree gur sabadh anahadh dhun sabadh bedhee gurusi'khan sunaae hai(n) ||

en.bdb: The heart piercing melodious tune which Satguru sings to his Sikhs is in fact manifestation of True Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਨਿਹਕਾਮ ਧਾਮ ਗੁਰੁਸਿਖ ਮਧੁਕਰ ਗਤਿ ਲਪਟਾਏ ਹਂੈ ॥੩੬॥
verses.translit_en: charan kamal makara(n)dh nihakaam dhaam gurusikh madhukar gat lapaTaae ha(n)ai ||36||

en.bdb: Fragrance of the dust (of the lotus feet of such Satguru) with which the Sikhs remain attached is capable of destroying all worldly desires. (36)
